title: Multi-scale roles of water in electrocatalytic CO2 and CO reduction
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,4303-4341
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS01088H, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xiaoyang He, Weiwen Zhou, Junxiong Chen, Qinghong Zhang, Ye Wang, Shunji Xie
This review presents the first comprehensive multi-scale framework for water regulation in CO2RR and CORR, outlining its roles across multi-scales, advanced regulation strategies, in situ characterization techniques, and future research directions.
